svg.text: Current implementation. How a department calls SevaOne: WSO2 API Manager, WSO2 Identity Server and the .NET backend.
Sends the citizen to the department
The citizen completes the real form
and pays here, on the department's own site
Holds its ApiKey and Client ID / secret
Routes /api/v1/dept/* to the department API on the gateway
Departments: revenue, health, rdpr, kaic, food,
Checks the stamped gateway secret. No secret, no entry: it fails closed.
Introspects the Bearer token, reads the dept:<code> scope, and checks the body departmentId matches.
DeptTokenGate: is the citizen token genuine
Decrypts the one-time token, looks up its hash, verifies the JWS signature and the department, and redeems it once.
Introspection verdicts, kept at most 60 s
redirect back with completion token (10 min)
token lookup · single-use redeem · application · status
